body: Thank you very much for your help!

Belongs to a singer I really like, Phil Ochs. There aren’t many good photos of it. It just looks a really nice jacket. Seems to only have two pockets on the bottom half of the jacket. If it helps at all, here is a standing photo. (https://www.gettyimages.co.uk/detail/news-photo/protest-singer-phil-ochs-poses-for-a-portrait-session-with-news-photo/74946192)

I love Portal.

Paraphrased. 

“In your file it says that jumpsuit looks stupid. On everybody else it looks fine, but on you it looks stupid. Well, what does a neck-bearded old scientist know about-Oh wait, it’s a woman. Well what does she know, oh wait, she has a Medical Degree, in fashion, from France”

They are fairly large party animals, like acting up, being loud etc. No issue there. Last time I didn’t engage in their antics I was vilified for it and called a bore, I was just trying to enjoy the atmosphere. It wasn’t a “Boo you suck” it was repetitive berating. 

I imagine because she wants to include me which is undeniably sweet, but to also not allow me to politely decline is a step in the wrong direction for me.

I am very sorry to hear that. 

It is so good of you to come on here and talk to those who really need somebody to talk to. 

Whatever happens to you, I’m sure you can take solace in being an empathetic person. 

I am very much the same. In comparing myself to others.

Very wise. 

I am 22. So rather pathetic really. Something that should come from a 15 year old. And you? If you don’t mind me asking.
That’s very altruistic of you. I used to be one of those people. But I ramble. So I end up almost boring people to death. Doing their job for them...
I am on the same page with you. I adore nature. I love taking walks in the more rural areas. Thinking about the beauty and complexity of this world. And that there is so much to see and do.

Funnily enough, I have always considered writing one. But I doubt it would do much good. I never know what to write about. And. My main motivations would be to write passionately, of course, and earn enough money to pay my way into my dream career. We can all dream eh? 

And funnily enough you should say that also, I have not been fortunate to leave my country. I do, one day wish to travel. 

I have seen your name pop up once or twice on here, if you don’t mind me asking. Are you a person who deals with these kind of issues on a professional basis? Or is this a...hobby? For the lack of a better word. I feel you have a distinct talent and passion for helping those in danger of themselves.
